lore.short: A geisha ninja from the Scarlet Shadow, armed with dual fans and adorned in crimson maple and the meisen. In her twisted mind, death is the ultimate salvation.

skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description:
Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 Crimson / Death Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 Crimson / Death Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of Meisen-e. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30 (+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

skills.name: Meisen-e
skills.description: Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing up to two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

skills.name: Kaerazu
skills.description:
Hirara uses Kaerazu to unleash the Crimson Maple, dealing 150 (+65% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial Crimson Maple damage.

assist.desc: Hirara has high damage output in the early-to-mid game, but the delay in her skills makes landing them less consistent. Hirara works especially well with strong early-game heroes with CC, such as Angela and Minotaur, allowing her to build an early advantage more easily.

strong.desc: Hirara's high mobility allows her to dive the enemy backline with ease, making her an excellent counter to squishy heroes who lack self-protection, like Ixia and Pharsa.The untargetable effect from Hirara's 2nd + 1st Combo Skill is great against delayed skills that deal high damage, giving her a big advantage when facing heroes like Yin and Gusion.

weak.desc: However, while Hirara is quick and nimble, she is also quite fragile. Against burst Assassins with targeted abilities, such as Saber and Natalia, it can be difficult to predict their attacks and use her 2nd + 1st Combo Skill in time. If she gets caught, she'll be taken down instantly.
